title: Timing evidence mapped to the NIST IR 8323 PNT profile
framework: NIST IR 8323 Rev. 1, Foundational PNT Profile: Applying the Cybersecurity Framework for the Responsible Use of Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) Services (2023), Cybersecurity Framework 1.1 subcategories
wording: Each item below is mapped to a Cybersecurity Framework subcategory as the profile applies it to timing users, and lists the evidence this report carries for it. The profile is voluntary guidance; the report gives evidence an assessor may use and does not state that any profile target is met.

items.summary: Physical devices and systems that use or provide time are inventoried.
items.operator: Confirm the inventory is complete for the scope of the assessment.

items.summary: Asset vulnerabilities are identified and documented: here, how long each clock holds its limit without its reference.
items.operator: Record the reference-loss causes considered (jamming, spoofing, network failure, outage).

items.summary: The timing sources are monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events: each clock has a measured record from its own I2 source.
items.operator: State how often each record is collected and who reviews it.

items.summary: Incident alert thresholds are established: each limit is a stated value and each clock has a warning time against it.
items.operator: Confirm the limits match the operator's requirements.

items.summary: Event data are collected and kept: the per-clock evidence history is hash-chained and the report is signed.
items.operator: State the retention period of the evidence history.

items.summary: A recovery plan is executed during or after an event: the time to breach bounds how long a clock may run on holdover before the plan must act.
items.operator: Name the recovery action and its expected duration for each clock whose warning time is within the horizon.
